idea-plugin.name: Cranpose
idea-plugin.description:
Cranpose development tools for IntelliJ IDEA and RustRover, with a tool window written in Cranpose.

  • Discover Cargo workspace binaries and examples that use Cranpose.
  • Check, run and test targets with build output in the IDE.
  • Code / Split / Preview editors with compiled component fixtures, viewport controls and PNG export.
  • Live layout trees, element picking, bounds, modifier properties and navigation to composable origins.
  • Rust/Cranpose preview controls and inspector, with plugin-owned debug hot reload that preserves compatible live state.
  • Persistent Cargo run configurations and source-linked compiler diagnostics.
  • Inline stability badges on Rust parameters, with explanations from the standalone Cranpose stability linter.
  • Composable gutter markers, source navigation and component completions.
  • File → New Project → Cranpose, using the Cranpose Showcase starter.
  • Live literal diamonds and Cranpose floating controls with editor Undo, plus shader editor accents.

Install Rust and the platform build tools to compile applications. Project creation works offline without Git. The plugin owns preview instrumentation and leaves application release builds unchanged. JetBrains Rust support provides full Rust language editing.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.12.0 — First Marketplace release.

  • Cranpose 0.1.169 with the latest pinned Showcase starter, bundled for offline project creation.
  • Automatic desktop configuration and first preview from New Project, with Rust setup and retry controls.
  • Live strings, format text, numbers, colors and resolvable variables; seekbars, inline swatches and editor Undo.
  • Layout inspection, source navigation, stability badges and animated shader feedback.
  • Verified native hosts and Cranpose UI for macOS, Linux and Windows on x86-64 and ARM64.
